verdict.rationale: Square has no first-party automation builder in the evidence. Background automation is only possible indirectly: Square Webhooks deliver event notifications to your own code, the SDKs let that code call the APIs, and the official MCP server lets an external agent act on Square. The user would have to build and host the automation themselves. Missing for 10: a native automation/workflow feature, scheduled or autonomous agent execution, any documentation of background automations running unattended, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
